decisions.reason: As a semi-hard cheese closely aligned with the firm's existing cheese capabilities and organic supply base, it fits high absorptive capacity and its continued promotion after launch suggests enough market acceptance to justify further incremental improvement.

This spicy cheese builds directly on established cheese knowledge, so the firm can readily learn from early sales and refine it, and its own product page indicates it earned a viable place in the range.

The mild creamy soft cheese is strongly related to the firm's core dairy competences, making commercial learning and product adjustment relatively easy, and the dedicated presentation after launch signals promising results.

Although technically related to the firm's cheese business, its disappearance from the website by 2019 suggests weak early performance or limited strategic traction, so absorptive capacity is better deployed on stronger adjacent products.
